name: mcp-shield
description: Security scanner for MCP servers. Detects SSRF, injection, path traversal, credential exposure, and more across 20 rules.

tools.name: shield_scan_file
tools.description: Scan a file for MCP security vulnerabilities. Returns findings with severity, CWE references, and fix suggestions.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to scan

tools.name: shield_scan_directory
tools.description: Scan an entire directory for MCP security vulnerabilities. Recursively checks all Python files.

directory_path.description: Absolute path to the directory to scan

tools.name: shield_scan_code
tools.description: Scan a code snippet for MCP security vulnerabilities. Pass code directly without needing a file.
